references.title: Course availability and sign-up limit settings
references.question: Q5
references.take: Course Availability groups Start date and Sign-up limit under Limits, with no-limit and limited-sign-up options. Enrollment closing dates and over-capacity group attachment are not shown.

references.title: Select team members for course enrollment
references.question: Q5
references.take: A staged enrollment flow selects recipients before dates and reminders, a team invitation analogy that supports capacity-aware review before sending.

references.title: Enroll a learner in a course
references.question: Q5
references.take: An enrollment administration page pairs a course selector with an explicit Enroll action, showing a simple manual path that could sit beside capacity rules.

references.title: Invite members by email, CSV, or link with notification choice
references.question: Q6
references.take: The member-invite screen offers manual/CSV/link entry and an explicit Send invites versus Add without notification choice. It demonstrates notification intent, not email delivery or course enrollment completion.

references.title: Invite users with optional email notification
references.question: Q6
references.take: An invite modal makes notification opt-in explicit and pairs it with a copy-link path, giving admins control over the learner communication seam.

references.title: Invite members with confirmation-email exception
references.question: Q6
references.take: Workspace-invite counterexample: selecting Skip confirmation email produces an Enterprise-only error and an invitation failure. The screen makes the failed action visible; it does not demonstrate a course enrollment outcome.

references.title: Join a full booking waitlist with preferred dates and confirmation
references.question: Q5
references.take: Booking analogy: a full date leads to date/time preferences, a first-visit question, payment/notes review and Join the waitlist. It does not establish course-level capacity, queue priority or automatic promotion.

references.title: Admin waitlist with automated availability notifications
references.question: Q6
references.take: The admin waitlist view explains automatic notifications and shows requests in a table with client and availability preferences, a useful notification and exception analogy.

references.title: Full schedule offers waitlist link
references.question: Q5
references.take: A full schedule keeps alternative times visible and places a Join the waitlist link directly below them, preserving forward progress when capacity is exhausted.

references.title: Event page with zero spots and Join Waitlist
references.question: Q5
references.take: The event CTA combines a zero-spots indicator with Join Waitlist, making capacity state and the next action legible in one place.
